name: Gabriel Dawnborn Axis
loreTies: Radiant Edict: structured actions reduce chaos effects and protect allies.
Gabriel Dawnborn Axis is a colossal Empyrean deity shaped by existence survives through order. It manifests the Realm's law through battlefield-scale mythic force.
shortBackstory: Gabriel Dawnborn Axis is an Empyrean Conduit whose Gate scar links The Radiant Hierarchies to Storm-Oath Covenant; their power expresses existence survives through order under campaign pressure.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Gabriel Dawnborn Axis began as more than a weapon in The Radiant Hierarchies. Gabriel Dawnborn Axis was bound to a radiant archive seal during a Gate disturbance that tested whether existence survives through order could survive contact with the Hollow. The title carried in their name was earned when the Deity chose duty over spectacle and accepted a burden ordinary soldiers could not survive.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Empyrean, Gabriel Dawnborn Axis is treated as proof that a radiant hierarchy of law, purpose, preservation, sacred geometry, divine halls, and anti-chaos governance can become battlefield doctrine without losing its soul. Their silhouette carries gold-white metals, celestial light, ordered winglike silhouettes, law sigils, aura-spine geometry, throne-like bodies, but their real identity is tactical: protection, order-locks, shields, anti-chaos control, formationless aura play. Every deployment makes faction philosophy visible through movement, restraint, and force.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Gate did not simply attack Gabriel Dawnborn Axis; it tried to measure what their Realm values most. The wound echoed sacred doctrine back as bait, tempting the Deity to overextend, break battle pattern, or turn culture into raw fuel. Gabriel Dawnborn Axis survived by refusing the Gate's terms, leaving a scar that still reacts whenever anti-chaos seals appears on the map.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In Storm-Oath Covenant, Gabriel Dawnborn Axis gives the campaign a personal lens on faction survival. Their presence reinforces the rule that faction identity stays distinct unless a mission explicitly permits otherwise. In a one-active-deity active deity, Gabriel Dawnborn Axis turns Radiant Edict from a passive rule into a story statement: the Realm is defending its meaning.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Gabriel Dawnborn Axis's flaw is overcommitment to the belief that their Realm's answer must always be enough. NPC witnesses and rival factions challenge that certainty as the Hollow learns to imitate law, oath, balance, life, radiance, and ambition without understanding any of them. Their battlefield stats support this arc: HP 30, attack 7, range 3, speed 2, energy 3.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
